title: Sakana Chat Adds Fugu and Browser Code Execution
summary: The Japan-focused assistant now turns Japanese instructions into runnable apps, games, charts and documents without requiring a login.
body:
## A Japanese assistant moves beyond question answering

Tokyo-based Sakana AI has released a major update to Sakana Chat, adding its Fugu multi-agent system, a new generation of the Japanese-focused Namazu model and the ability to execute generated code inside the browser. The service remains free and can be used without creating an account, although registered users receive conversation history and higher usage limits.

The new execution environment allows users to describe an application, utility or game in Japanese and then run the generated result directly in the chat interface. Sakana’s examples range from educational worksheets and simple browser games to spreadsheet analysis, chart creation and presentation materials. That combination shifts Sakana Chat from a localized conversational assistant toward a lightweight agent workspace capable of producing and testing artifacts.

The two model components serve different roles. Namazu is Sakana’s effort to adapt a strong foundation model to Japanese language, culture and local requirements while retaining broad reasoning and coding performance. Fugu is designed as a model-orchestration layer: it can select and coordinate multiple underlying models, then return one synthesized response through a conventional model interface. Sakana has not published a new standalone set of Namazu weights as part of this product update, so the event is a service rollout rather than an open-weight release.

## Why it matters

Most coding-agent products are designed first around English-language developer workflows. Sakana is instead packaging executable generation for Japanese consumers, children and office workers, with no-login access reducing the initial barrier to experimentation. Its business-oriented spreadsheet and document examples also place it closer to general knowledge-work agents than to a conventional chatbot.

The update is significant less because browser code execution is unique than because Sakana is combining it with Japan-specific post-training and multi-model orchestration in a single public product. Adoption and reliability will show whether localized agent systems can build durable advantages against global assistants that support Japanese but are not designed around Japanese workflows and cultural context.
title_zh: Sakana Chat 接入 Fugu，并新增浏览器代码执行
summary_zh: 升级后的日本本土助手可把日语描述直接变成可运行的应用、游戏、图表和文档，无需注册即可免费使用。
body_zh:
## 从问答助手转向可执行工作台

总部位于东京的 Sakana AI 对 Sakana Chat 进行了大规模升级：接入多智能体系统 Fugu 和新一代日语模型 Namazu，并新增浏览器内代码执行功能。服务目前仍可免费使用，用户无需注册账号即可开始对话；注册后则能保存历史记录并获得更高的使用额度。

升级后的执行环境允许用户直接用日语描述想要的应用、工具或游戏，系统生成代码后可在聊天界面中立即运行。Sakana 展示的使用场景包括学习练习题、简单网页游戏、电子表格分析、图表生成以及演示资料制作。这意味着 Sakana Chat 不再只是回答问题，而是开始成为一个能够生成、运行和检验实际成果的轻量级智能体工作台。

两个模型组件承担不同职责。Namazu 是 Sakana 将高性能基础模型适配到日语、当地文化和日本本土需求的模型系列，同时尽量保留通用推理与编程能力。Fugu 则是模型编排层，可根据任务选择并协调多个底层模型，再通过一个常规模型接口输出整合后的答案。此次产品更新并未同步发布一套新的 Namazu 独立权重，因此应视为在线服务升级，而非开放权重发布。

## 为何值得关注

当前多数编程智能体首先围绕英文开发者工作流设计。Sakana 选择把可执行生成能力直接提供给日本消费者、学生和办公人群，同时用免登录方式降低首次尝试门槛。电子表格分析和资料制作等示例，也让它更接近通用知识工作智能体，而不只是编程聊天机器人。

浏览器内执行代码本身并非独有功能，这次更新的意义在于，Sakana 将日本本土化后训练、多模型编排和可运行产物整合进了同一个公共产品。后续的用户采用情况与任务可靠性，将检验本土化智能体能否对支持日语、但并非围绕日本工作方式和文化语境设计的全球助手形成持久优势。
